# 2 Chronicles Chapter 32 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** After the-things these and-the-faithfulness this came Sennacherib king-of Assyria and-he-came against-Judah and-he-camped against the-cities the-fortified and-he-said to-break-them-open to-himself.

**2** And-he-saw Hezekiah that came Sennacherib and-his-face was for-war against Jerusalem.

**3** And-he-counseled with his-princes and-his-mighty-men to-stop waters-of the-springs that were-from-outside to-the-city and-they-helped-him.

**4** And-they-gathered people much and-they-stopped all the-springs and-the-brook the-flowing through-midst-of the-land saying why should-come kings-of Assyria and-they-find waters many.

**5** And-he-strengthened-himself and-he-built all the-wall the-broken and-he-raised upon the-towers and-to-outside the-wall another and-he-strengthened the-Millo city-of David and-he-made weapons for-abundance and-shields.

**6** And-he-put commanders-of war over the-people and-he-gathered-them to-him to square-of gate-of the-city and-he-spoke to their-heart saying

**7** be-strong and-be-courageous do-not fear and-do-not be-dismayed from-before king-of Assyria and-from-before all the-multitude that is-with-him for with-us is-more than with-him.

**8** With-him is-arm-of flesh and-with-us is-YHWH our-God to-help-us and-to-fight our-battles and-they-leaned the-people on words-of Hezekiah king-of Judah.

**9** After this sent Sennacherib king-of Assyria his-servants to-Jerusalem and-he was-on Lachish and-all his-dominion with-him to Hezekiah king-of Judah and-to all Judah that was-in Jerusalem saying

**10** thus says Sennacherib king-of Assyria on what are-you trusting and-you-are-sitting in-siege in-Jerusalem.

**11** Is-not Hezekiah inciting you to-give you to-death by-famine and-by-thirst saying YHWH our-God will-deliver-us from-hand-of king-of Assyria.

**12** Is-not he Hezekiah removed his-high-places and-his-altars and-he-said to-Judah and-to-Jerusalem saying before altar one you-shall-worship and-upon-it you-shall-burn-incense.

**13** Do-not you-know what I did I and-my-fathers to-all peoples-of the-lands were-able they-could gods-of nations-of the-lands to-deliver their-land from-my-hand.

**14** Who among-all gods-of these nations that devoted-to-destruction my-fathers who could deliver his-people from-my-hand that your-God could deliver you from-my-hand.

**15** And-now do-not let-deceive you Hezekiah and-do-not let-him-incite you like-this and-do-not believe-him for not could any god-of any nation and-kingdom to-deliver his-people from-my-hand and-from-hand-of my-fathers how-much-less your-God will-deliver you from-my-hand.

**16** And-more spoke his-servants against YHWH God and-against Hezekiah His-servant.

**17** And-letters he-wrote to-reproach YHWH God-of Israel and-to-say against-Him saying as-gods-of nations-of the-lands that not delivered their-people from-my-hand so not will-deliver God-of Hezekiah His-people from-my-hand.

**18** And-they-called with-a-voice great in-Judean to people-of Jerusalem who were-on the-wall to-frighten-them and-to-terrify-them so-that they-may-capture the-city.

**19** And-they-spoke against God-of Jerusalem as-against gods-of peoples-of the-earth work-of hands-of the-man.

**20** And-he-prayed Hezekiah the-king and-Isaiah son-of Amoz the-prophet about this and-they-cried to the-heavens.

**21** And-He-sent YHWH an-angel and-he-destroyed every mighty-of valor and-leader and-commander in-camp-of king-of Assyria and-he-returned in-shame-of face to-his-land and-he-came to-house-of his-god and-from-those-going-out-of his-loins they-felled-him there with-the-sword.

**22** And-He-saved YHWH Hezekiah and-inhabitants-of Jerusalem from-hand-of Sennacherib king-of Assyria and-from-hand-of all and-He-guided-them from-all-around.

**23** And-many were-bringing gifts to-YHWH to-Jerusalem and-precious-things to-Hezekiah king-of Judah and-he-was-exalted in-eyes-of all the-nations from-then.

**24** In-the-days those was-sick Hezekiah to-death and-he-prayed to YHWH and-He-spoke to-him and-a-sign He-gave to-him.

**25** And-not according-to-the-dealing upon-him returned Hezekiah for was-lifted his-heart and-there-was wrath upon-him and-upon Judah and-Jerusalem.

**26** And-he-humbled-himself Hezekiah in-lifting-of his-heart he and-inhabitants-of Jerusalem and-not came upon-them wrath-of YHWH in-days-of Hezekiah.

**27** And-there-was to-Hezekiah riches and-honor great very and-treasuries he-made for-himself for-silver and-for-gold and-for-precious stone and-for-spices and-for-shields and-for-all vessels-of desire.

**28** And-storehouses for-produce-of grain and-new-wine and-oil and-stalls for-every kind-of cattle and-cattle and-flocks for-stalls.

**29** And-cities he-made for-himself and-possessions-of sheep and-cattle for-abundance for gave to-him God possessions great very.

**30** And-he Hezekiah stopped source-of waters-of upper Gihon and-he-directed-them to-the-lower to-west to-city-of David and-he-prospered Hezekiah in-all his-work.

**31** And-so in-matter-of ambassadors-of princes-of Babylon the-sent to-him to-inquire about the-sign that was in-the-land left-him God to-test-him to-know all that-was in-his-heart.

**32** And-rest-of acts-of Hezekiah and-his-lovingkindnesses behold-them written in-vision-of Isaiah son-of Amoz the-prophet on book-of kings-of Judah and-Israel.

**33** And-he-lay-down Hezekiah with his-fathers and-they-buried-him in-ascent-of tombs-of sons-of David and-honor did to-him in-his-death all Judah and-inhabitants-of Jerusalem and-he-reigned Manasseh his-son in-his-place.


---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **32:8**: arm-of flesh...YHWH our-God — The most concise contrast in Chronicles between human power and divine power. Flesh versus deity, finite versus infinite.

- **32:19**: as-against gods-of peoples-of the-earth — Sennacherib's fatal error: treating YHWH as comparable to man-made gods. This theological miscategorization seals his doom.

- **32:31**: left-him God to-test-him — The divine withdrawal is a test. God steps back to reveal what is in Hezekiah's heart — a motif echoing Deuteronomy 8:2.


— EMET
